name: THE SPEEDWAY
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: The map lays the speedway beside the air base ('SPEEDWAY (EDC / LVMS)', engine/bohemia_overmap.js: four cells by three, the Las Vegas Motor Speedway and its festival ground).
The dead's own line for the kind (engine/bohemia_dead.js): 'the infield camp'.

A speedway's infield holds the garage row: team bays side by side, each a car on jack stands with its tool chests, tyre stacks and fuel jugs, block walls between the bays, the haulers parked in a line behind; and the inspection shed: cars up on lifts, the scales, the template racks, the parts shelves, a floor drain.

On house tiles a bay's dividing wall, a hauler, a rack and the parts shelves each hide a man; a car on its stands or up on a lift is cover; the shed's backed-up drain is standing water, Battle Brothers' swamp.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (speedway_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The speedway is mostly its track, its grandstands and its infield: about one fight in three there is fought under a roof, in the garage row or the inspection shed, by the cell's own dice; the rest out on the asphalt.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words); 'sight' says whether a blocker hides a man ('blocked', the obstacles row) or is seen past ('seen'). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The garage's block wall: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The infield's sealed concrete, rubber marks on it: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

hauler.effect: A team's hauler, a semi trailer with its ramp down and its bays emptied: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its boulder.

divider.effect: The block wall between two bays: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its wall.

racecar.effect: A race car up on its jack stands, its wheels off: cover.
racecar.say: A race car on stands: cover.

toolchest.effect: A team's tool chest, steel drawers as tall as a man's chest: cover.

tyres.effect: Racing tyres stacked by the bay: low cover.

jugs.effect: Fuel jugs and oil drums, most of them empty: low cover.

lift.effect: A car up on a lift, its posts and its body over a man's head: cover.
lift.say: A car on a lift: cover.

shelves.effect: The parts shelves, floor to ceiling: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

templates.effect: The inspection templates hung on their racks: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

drain.effect: The shed's floor drain backed up, oily water standing on the floor: slow going (4 AP), and a man standing in it fights worse. [bb] its swamp.
drain.say: Standing water: slow going, and you fight worse in it.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a drum. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The garage's doors, rolled up onto the infield: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in speedway_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: a hauler's roof is a ladder nobody climbs under fire on house tiles; the grandstands are outside.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the garage row's steel roof and the shed's trusses, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the warehouse's roof).
